name: Translation Views
description: Create customized lists and queries of translations from your database.
project_description:
Provides fields and filter to build list in Views with information about translations.

 As example you can identify which nodes that do not have translations in a specified target language and give operation links to add, edit or delete translations.

 All entities are supported as long as the content translation is enabled.

 Back to top 

 Views fields/filters 
 The fields/filters will display information about the current content in the selected target language:

 
 Target translation language 
 Translation status 
 Translation outdated 
 Translation moderation state 
 Translation changed time 
 Translation counter 
 Translation operations 
 Target language equals default language 
 Translation source of target language equals row language 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 PHP 7+

 Back to top 

 Integration 
 You can limit the target language and source language to the translators registered translation skills by installing Translators .

 Back to top 

 Install and configurations 
 There is a demo view installed with the module named "Content translation jobs". Please review README file for more information about install and configuration.

 Back to top
